request.system: You are an API endpoint. Every response is a single JSON object and nothing else.

messages.content:
Assign the three-character ICD-10-AM principal diagnosis category for the episode below. Respond with exactly {"code": "<letter><digit><digit>", "condition": "<short name>"} and no other text.

Hospital course:
DISCHARGE SUMMARY:

Patient:
• Name: Not provided
• Age: 24-year-old
• Gender: Male

Hospitalization Dates:
• Admission: [not provided]
• Discharge: POD #20
Admission Diagnosis: [diagnosis section withheld]
Hospital Course:
• Patient underwent uncomplicated orthotopic liver transplantation after multiple thoracenteses for symtomatic relief of persistent right-sided hepatic hydrothorax.
• Patient presented with respiratory distress and left-sided infiltrates consistent with pneumonia on POD #5 after OLT. Patient was started on antibiotics and underwent a right-sided therapeutic thoracentesis with removal of 1.3 liters of fluid.
• Post-thoracentesis chest imaging revealed a large hydropneumothorax that was treated with a small-bore chest tube.
• Diagnostic bronchoscopy was not performed due to the absence of endobronchial obstruction on CT.
• Patient was stable without dyspnea and hypoxemia, so video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery was deferred after consultation with thoracic surgery.
• Patient was discharged home on POD #20 without supplemental oxygen.
• Follow-up chest x-ray 1 month later showed improvement in the hydropneumothorax and a chest x-ray obtained 6 months later showed near-complete re-expansion of the right lung without surgical intervention.

Discharge Instructions:
• Follow-up with liver transplant team as needed.
• Follow-up with primary care physician for ongoing care.

Respond with the JSON object only, starting with { and ending with }.

text:
The episode centers on a complication after a transplant: a hydropneumothorax following therapeutic thoracentesis, in a patient with hepatic hydrothorax. Several codes could fit.

- Hepatic hydrothorax: K76.7 (hepatorenal) is not right. Hepatic hydrothorax is generally coded J91* (pleural effusion in conditions classified elsewhere) with an underlying liver disease code.
- Pneumothorax after thoracentesis: J95.8 (other postprocedural respiratory disorders) or J93.8. Iatrogenic pneumothorax is coded J95.8 in ICD-10-AM.
- Liver transplant status: Z94.4.

The principal diagnosis for this episode is the hydropneumothorax that was treated with a chest tube, and it arose as a procedural complication. The relevant category is J95, postprocedural respiratory disorders, not elsewhere classified.

{"code": "J95", "condition": "Postprocedural respiratory disorder (iatrogenic hydropneumothorax after thoracentesis)"}
